fields.name: completed_placements
fields.description: An integer counting completed placements of the goal-specified cube onto the target through the current decision step. Start at 0. Increase by one at the first decision step after each completed placement, not when the placement subgoal is selected. Pickups leave the count unchanged, including pickups from the target for another repetition. The values at successive decision steps are [0, 0, 1, 1, 2] for episodes 20 and 77, [0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3] for episode 21, and [0, 0, 1] for episodes 30 and 84. e.g. 0
